properties.name: Northern debris-flood fan
properties.description: Debris flood / mudflow deposit; feeder channel enters from the west outside the survey, LS-02 runout also drains into it

properties.name: Narrow northern debris flow
properties.description: Long narrow scar on forested slope; channelised runout to the north-east into LS-01

properties.name: Twin-scar debris flow, north village
properties.description: Two adjoining scars merging into one runout that buried the west side of the northern village and reached the road between houses

properties.name: Stream-channel debris flow
properties.description: Channelised debris flow down a stream with two tributary scars; scoured the bed and reached the road

properties.name: Hillslope slide to road
properties.description: Short slide reaching the road from the west

properties.name: Narrow central debris flow
properties.description: Long narrow scar; runout reached the road and joins the LS-07 fan

properties.name: Central debris-flow complex
properties.description: Largest event: wide scoured source zone, runout through the village road and a fan across the paddies

properties.name: Long southern debris flow
properties.description: Long scar and channel; runout crossed the road junction into the paddies

properties.name: Southern slope failure
properties.description: Broad shallow failure of the forested slope at the south edge of the survey; continues beyond the flown area
